verses.original: עַל־ מִשְׁכָּבִי֙ בַּלֵּיל֔וֹת בִּקַּ֕שְׁתִּי אֵ֥ת שֶׁאָהֲבָ֖ה נַפְשִׁ֑י בִּקַּשְׁתִּ֖יו וְלֹ֥א מְצָאתִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- miš·kā·ḇî bal·lê·lō·wṯ biq·qaš·tî ’êṯ še·’ā·hă·ḇāh nap̄·šî biq·qaš·tîw wə·lō mə·ṣā·ṯîw
verses.literal: On my bed at night I sought the one I love I sought him but did not find him
verses.literalPt: De noite no meu leito, busquei aquele, a quem a minha alma ama: Busquei-o, porém não o achei.

verses.original: אָק֨וּמָה נָּ֜א וַאֲסוֹבְבָ֣ה בָעִ֗יר בַּשְּׁוָקִים֙ וּבָ֣רְחֹב֔וֹת אֲבַקְשָׁ֕ה אֵ֥ת שֶׁאָהֲבָ֖ה נַפְשִׁ֑י בִּקַּשְׁתִּ֖יו וְלֹ֥א מְצָאתִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·qū·māh nā wa·’ă·sō·wḇ·ḇāh ḇā·‘îr baš·šə·wā·qîm ū·ḇā·rə·ḥō·ḇō·wṯ ’ă·ḇaq·šāh ’êṯ še·’ā·hă·ḇāh nap̄·šî biq·qaš·tîw wə·lō mə·ṣā·ṯîw
verses.literal: I will arise now and go about the city through the streets and squares I will seek the one I love So I sought him but did not find him
verses.literalPt: Levantar-me-ei, pois, e rodearei a cidade; Pelas ruas e pelas praças Buscarei aquele a quem a minha alma ama: Busquei-o, porém não o achei.

verses.original: מְצָא֙וּנִי֙ הַשֹּׁ֣מְרִ֔ים הַסֹּבְבִ֖ים בָּעִ֑יר אֵ֛ת שֶׁאָהֲבָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖י רְאִיתֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mə·ṣā·’ū·nî haš·šō·mə·rîm has·sō·ḇə·ḇîm bā·‘îr ’êṯ še·’ā·hă·ḇāh nap̄·šî rə·’î·ṯem
verses.literal: I encountered the watchmen on their rounds of the city Have you seen the one I love
verses.literalPt: Encontraram-me os guardas que rondam a cidade, Aos quais disse eu: Vistes, porventura, aquele a quem a minha alma ama?

verses.original: כִּמְעַט֙ שֶׁעָבַ֣רְתִּי מֵהֶ֔ם עַ֣ד שֶֽׁמָּצָ֔אתִי אֵ֥ת שֶׁאָהֲבָ֖ה נַפְשִׁ֑י אֲחַזְתִּיו֙ וְלֹ֣א אַרְפֶּ֔נּוּ עַד־ שֶׁ֤הֲבֵיאתִיו֙ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית אִמִּ֔י וְאֶל־ חֶ֖דֶר הוֹרָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kim·‘aṭ še·‘ā·ḇar·tî mê·hem ‘aḏ šem·mā·ṣā·ṯî ’êṯ še·’ā·hă·ḇāh nap̄·šî ’ă·ḥaz·tîw wə·lō ’ar·pen·nū ‘aḏ- še·hă·ḇê·ṯîw ’el- bêṯ ’im·mî wə·’el- ḥe·ḏer hō·w·rā·ṯî
verses.literal: I had just passed them when I found the one I love I held him and would not let go until I had brought him to my mother’s house to the chamber of the one who conceived me
verses.literalPt: Apenas me tinha apartado deles, Quando achei aquele a quem a minha alma ama. Agarrei-me a ele, e não o deixei ir embora, Até tê-lo eu introduzido na casa de minha mãe, E na câmara daquela que me concebeu.

verses.original: הִשְׁבַּ֨עְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֜ם בְּנ֤וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ בִּצְבָא֔וֹת א֖וֹ בְּאַיְל֣וֹת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה אִם־ תָּעִ֧ירוּ׀ וְֽאִם־ תְּעֽוֹרְר֛וּ אֶת־ הָאַהֲבָ֖ה עַ֥ד שֶׁתֶּחְפָּֽץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: hiš·ba‘·tî ’eṯ·ḵem bə·nō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim biṣ·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ōw bə·’ay·lō·wṯ haś·śā·ḏeh ’im- tā·‘î·rū wə·’im- tə·‘ō·wr·rū ’eṯ- hā·’a·hă·ḇāh ‘aḏ šet·teḥ·pāṣ
verses.literal: O daughters of Jerusalem I adjure you by the gazelles and does of the field Do not arouse or awaken love until the time is right
verses.literalPt: Eu vos conjuro, filhas de Jerusalém, Pelas veadas e pelas gazelas do campo, Que não acordeis nem desperteis o amor, Até que queira.

verses.original: מִ֣י זֹ֗את עֹלָה֙ מִן־ הַמִּדְבָּ֔ר כְּתִֽימֲר֖וֹת עָשָׁ֑ן מְקֻטֶּ֤רֶת מוֹר֙ וּלְבוֹנָ֔ה מִכֹּ֖ל אַבְקַ֥ת רוֹכֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: mî zōṯ ‘ō·lāh min- ham·miḏ·bār kə·ṯî·mă·rō·wṯ ‘ā·šān mə·quṭ·ṭe·reṯ mō·wr ū·lə·ḇō·w·nāh mik·kōl ’aḇ·qaṯ rō·w·ḵêl
verses.literal: Who is this coming up from the wilderness like a column of smoke scented with myrrh and frankincense from all the spices of the merchant
verses.literalPt: Quem é esta que sobe do deserto como colunas de fumo, Perfumada de mirra e de incenso, De toda a sorte de pós aromáticos do mercador?

verses.original: הִנֵּ֗ה מִטָּתוֹ֙ שֶׁלִּשְׁלֹמֹ֔ה שִׁשִּׁ֥ים גִּבֹּרִ֖ים סָבִ֣יב לָ֑הּ מִגִּבֹּרֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh miṭ·ṭā·ṯōw šel·liš·lō·mōh šiš·šîm gib·bō·rîm sā·ḇîḇ lāh mig·gib·bō·rê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Behold it is Solomon’s carriage escorted by sixty of the mightiest men . . . of Israel
verses.literalPt: Eis aí a liteira de Salomão: Rodeiam-na sessenta valentes, Dos poderosos de Israel.

verses.original: כֻּלָּם֙ אֲחֻ֣זֵי חֶ֔רֶב מְלֻמְּדֵ֖י מִלְחָמָ֑ה אִ֤ישׁ חַרְבּוֹ֙ עַל־ יְרֵכ֔וֹ מִפַּ֖חַד בַּלֵּילּֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: kul·lām ’ă·ḥu·zê ḥe·reḇ mə·lum·mə·ḏê mil·ḥā·māh ’îš ḥar·bōw ‘al- yə·rê·ḵōw mip·pa·ḥaḏ bal·lēl·lōṯ
verses.literal: All are skilled with the sword experienced in warfare Each has his sword at his side prepared for the terror of the night
verses.literalPt: Todos eles manejam a espada, e são destros na guerra; Cada um tem a sua espada à coxa Por causa dos temores noturnos.

verses.original: אַפִּרְי֗וֹן עָ֤שָׂה לוֹ֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה מֵעֲצֵ֖י הַלְּבָנֽוֹן׃
verses.literal: King Solomon has made his carriage out of the timber of Lebanon
verses.literalPt: O rei Salomão fez para si um palanquim, De madeira do Líbano.

verses.original: עַמּוּדָיו֙ עָ֣שָׂה כֶ֔סֶף רְפִידָת֣וֹ זָהָ֔ב מֶרְכָּב֖וֹ אַרְגָּמָ֑ן תּוֹכוֹ֙ רָצ֣וּף אַהֲבָ֔ה מִבְּנ֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘am·mū·ḏāw ‘ā·śāh ḵe·sep̄ rə·p̄î·ḏā·ṯōw zā·hāḇ mer·kā·ḇōw ’ar·gā·mān tō·w·ḵōw rā·ṣūp̄ ’a·hă·ḇāh mib·bə·nō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: He has made its posts of silver its base of gold its seat of purple fabric Its interior is inlaid with love by the daughters of Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Fez-lhe as colunas de prata, E a base de ouro, e o assento de púrpura, Sendo-lhe o interior ornado com amor, Pelas filhas de Jerusalém.

verses.original: צְאֶ֧ינָה׀ וּֽרְאֶ֛ינָה בְּנ֥וֹת צִיּ֖וֹן בַּמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בָּעֲטָרָ֗ה שֶׁעִטְּרָה־ לּ֤וֹ אִמּוֹ֙ בְּי֣וֹם חֲתֻנָּת֔וֹ וּבְי֖וֹם שִׂמְחַ֥ת לִבּֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ṣə·’e·nāh ū·rə·’e·nāh bə·nō·wṯ ṣî·yō·wn bam·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh bā·‘ă·ṭā·rāh še·‘iṭ·ṭə·rāh- lōw ’im·mōw bə·yō·wm ḥă·ṯun·nā·ṯōw ū·ḇə·yō·wm śim·ḥaṯ lib·bōw
verses.literal: Come out O daughters of Zion and gaze at King Solomon wearing the crown with which his mother crowned him on the day of his wedding the day of his heart’s rejoicing
verses.literalPt: Saí, filhas de Sião, e contemplai o rei Salomão, Com a coroa de que sua mãe o coroou no dia do seu desposório, E no dia do júbilo do seu coração.
